TextView.android:text:
This app is solely ment for chatting,calling and video calling using android bluetooth technology
 bluetooth consumes battery so by default this app does'nt automatically start,to use the functionalities of this app bluetooth must be enabled if you intend to scan for devices using this app then location permission must be granted
 Eccles never access ur location using this app,so the location permission is solely used to discover devices
 if you intend to send images,audios or videos through this app you must grant storage permission which will be requested by this app, microphone permission is neccessary to record and send voice notes
 if you are using android 10 or higher be sure to grant manage all files permission in Settings->apps->Eccles Bluechat->permissions->Manage All files, this is nessary if you want to view your received files outside this app
 if you did not grant any of these permissions trying to use their feature can lead to undesirable behavior of this app, make sure to use the exit option in the options menu located at the top right conner of this app when you are done using this app, this is neccessary to optimse system resources held by this app, if you encountered any problem while using this app refer to the app settings->report and send your feedback to Eccles, Eccles will do their best to make sure your problem is resolved
 for more information on how to use this app refer to the app help in the apps options menu located in the top right conner of this app.
